newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.1 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.1 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, July 29 were expected to total $1.1 billion in 40 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $700 million in 22 sales, with a $159 million Massachusetts Port Authority offering through Bear, Stearns & Co., Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 18 sales totaling $397 million are scheduled. A 215 million Minnesota offering at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional six sales totaling $144 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
